name: fixora
description: Fixora, a local services marketplace (MERN, microservices)

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run env:init
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix Backend/services/api-gateway install && npm --prefix Backend/services/auth-service install && npm --prefix Backend/services/booking-service install && npm --prefix Backend/services/mail-service install && npm --prefix Frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n mail,auth,booking,gateway,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta,green,blue "npm --prefix Backend/services/mail-service run dev" "npm --prefix Backend/services/auth-service run dev" "npm --prefix Backend/services/booking-service run dev" "npm --prefix Backend/services/api-gateway run dev" "npm --prefix Frontend run dev"
